configuration.objective: mean three original-mask phase MSE; retain all1170 RMSE
configuration.modeling_goals: All three phase RMSEs <= same-precision actual old control; SET subset also reported
configuration.preflight_rule: All three seed RMSEs below same-precision old in both precisions; each gap exceeds sum of observed old/seed nominal-refined RMSE differences
configuration.unknown_direction_policy: Full requested round may accept best completed feasible improvement, flagged uncertified; without such improvement stop unresolved, do not shrink
configuration.incomplete_round_policy: Keep preceding incumbent; never select a point from a budget-interrupted round
configuration.grid_stop_scope: Only declared-domain feasible coordinate directions at final incumbent and step .005; not continuous stationarity, KKT, global optimum, or diagonal search
